Currently covered until {date} — the grant extends it from there.

DeclineBookingDialog.title: Decline this reservation request?
DeclineBookingDialog.body: This declines {guest}'s request and emails them your reason. It can't be undone, so please explain your decision briefly and courteously.
DeclineBookingDialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. These dates are no longer available for booking.
CancelBookingDialog.title: Cancel this confirmed booking?
CancelBookingDialog.bodyOnline: {guest} is notified by email with your reason and gets a full refund — host cancellations are never the guest's cost. Repeated cancellations are reviewed. This can't be undone.
CancelBookingDialog.bodyCash: {guest} is notified by email with your reason and the dates reopen. Use this when a guest has gone unresponsive about a cash stay — try WhatsApp or email first. Repeated cancellations are reviewed. This can't be undone.
CancelBookingDialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. The apartment needs urgent repairs and can't host these dates.
ConfirmBookingDialog.chargedNow: Their card will be charged now and they'll be notified by email.
ConfirmBookingDialog.payAtProperty: They will be notified by email and pay you at the property.
ConfirmBookingDialog.title: Confirm this booking?
ConfirmBookingDialog.body: {guest}'s stay is committed for these dates. {payment} Any other requests for the same nights are declined automatically.

bookingStatusExplanation.SEO.title: Booking statuses, explained
bookingStatusExplanation.SEO.description: A quick guide to what each booking status means — pending, confirmed, checked in, checked out and cancelled.
bookingStatusExplanation.title: Booking statuses, explained
bookingStatusExplanation.subtitle: Every booking moves through a few simple stages. Here's what each status means, so you always know where things stand.
bookingStatusExplanation.pendingDescript: The booking request has been sent and is waiting for the host to confirm. Nothing is charged until it's accepted.
bookingStatusExplanation.confirmedDescri: The host has accepted the booking. The dates are reserved and a confirmation email has been sent.
bookingStatusExplanation.checkedInDescri: The guest has arrived and the stay is currently in progress.
bookingStatusExplanation.checkedOutDescr: The stay is finished and the guest has checked out.
bookingStatusExplanation.cancelledDescri: The booking was called off — by the guest or host — and the dates have been released.
bookingStatusExplanation.cancelledPolicy: Guests can cancel a confirmed stay for free when check-in is at least 7 days away. Inside that window, contact the host directly.
